_note: One customer, one file. This is what makes a branded build possible without touching code: the address, the identity on the home screen, and the version counter all live here. `npm run build:apk -- --client=hadas` reads it. A new customer is a copy of this file — see docs/09-ANDROID-APP.md §10.
label: הדס

app._note: applicationId is the customer's app identity on the device, and what a device-management filter approves. SafeTech approved com.ctrlplusf.incontrol and confirmed the approval follows the PACKAGE ID, so this build keeps it: a suffixed id would be a different app to Android and to them, needing a fresh review and installing alongside instead of over. Never change it once a customer is live.
app.name: הדס

version._note: Per customer, because Android compares versionCode against what is installed on THAT device. Written back by the release script on every build — do not edit by hand.

_hosting: Served from the vendor server rather than Vercel: the tablet WebView loads this host and would not load the Vercel one, on a device where Chrome loaded both. Same code, same Supabase project, same data — only the origin differs. Rebuild with scripts/mirror-hadas.mjs whenever production changes.
